title: Query Learning Nearly Pauli Sparse Unitaries in Diamond Distance
summary: We study the problem of learning nearly $(s,ε)$-sparse unitaries, meaning that the Pauli spectrum is concentrated on at most $s$ components with at most $ε$ residual mass in Pauli $\ell_1$-norm. This class generalizes well-studied families, including sparse unitaries, quantum $k$-juntas, $2^k$-Pauli dimensional channels, and compositions of depth $O(\log\log n)$ circuits with near-Clifford circuits. Given query access to an unknown nearly sparse unitary $U$, our goal is to efficiently (both in time and query complexity) construct a quantum channel that is close in diamond distance to $U$. We…
